name: green-zone-straddle-bottom-cross
note: TRUTH TABLE ROW — a genuine crossing of the BOTTOM edge (low=89 < 90, high=100 > 90). Both predicates terminate at bar 2 and mitigate. The bottom-edge CONTROL row for the mutation proof, and the proof that straddle's mitigated flag is not accidentally tied to the top edge alone.
source:
indicator("SB", shorttitle="SB", overlay=true)
spawn = bar_index == 0
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "T", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "S", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, mitigated_color=color.gray)
